verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Microsoft Graph as a single REST endpoint with a documented user-list API and SCIM provisioning APIs for users/groups, giving developers programmable directory access. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of groups endpoints, app-assignment APIs, pagination, or filtering mechanics, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec. Missing for 10: explicit groups API docs, app-role-assignment API docs, pagination/filtering documentation, and a machine-readable API spec.
